Definition: Zabdi, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zabdi = "endowment"; 1) son of Zerah and grandson of Judah; grandfather of Achan; 2) one of the sons of Shimhi, a Benjamite; 3) an officer of David, in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine-cellars; 4) son of Asaph the minstrel; also called 'Zaccur' and 'Zichri'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
